app.name: Long Walks Atlas
app.description: A map of long-distance walking trails around the world: pilgrim ways, historic routes, coastal and mountain paths, with length, days on foot and a link to each official site.

disclaimer.short: Lines on the map are schematic. For the exact route, see each trail's official website.
disclaimer.trail: The line on the map is schematic and may differ from the waymarked trail. For the exact route, its stages and current changes, see the official website: {{site}}.

og.tagline: Pilgrim ways, historic routes, coastal and mountain trails around the world, on one map.

atlas.title: Long-distance hiking trails of the world on a map
atlas.mapFailed: The map could not be shown on this device.

filters.none: No trail matches. Try clearing a filter.

badge.coe-cultural-route: Cultural Route of the Council of Europe

trail.lengthFromMap: Length measured on the OpenStreetMap line; no official figure checked yet.
trail.fallback: There is no translation yet, so this text is in English.
trail.daysEstimated: No source gives the days on foot, so they are worked out from the length at {{pace}} a day.

hub.each: Each comes with its length, days on foot, best months and a link to the official site.
